title: Upload client recap
outcome: The upload client now retries a failed request three times, and a pull request is open. The retry is tested; the timeout change is not.

open.what: Decide whether the timeout stays at 30 s or goes to 60 s.
The timeout change in `client.py` has no test.
Review and merge the pull request.

done.what: Added a retry with backoff to `upload()` in `client.py`.
Raised the request timeout from 10 s to 30 s.
done.detail: The value is changed. No test covers it, and the 60 s option was not decided.

done.what: Explained why the old client dropped uploads over 5 MB.
Ran the integration suite against staging.
done.detail: The staging host refused the connection, so no integration test ran.

done.what: Opened a pull request for the retry.

decisions.what: Three retries with a doubling wait, starting at 1 s.
decisions.why: You picked it over five retries to keep the worst case under 10 s.

decisions.what: The retry covers only 5xx responses and network errors.
decisions.why: A 4xx response will fail again the same way.

decisions.what: The log level for a retry is `WARNING`.

commits.subject: feat: retry failed uploads with backoff

asked.text: The upload keeps failing on big files. Can you make it retry?

asked.note: Raise the request timeout; the new value was not given, so 30 s was used.

gaps: The pull request's CI result was not read.
